request.description: Launch a saved Kedi program. Attach is not supported.

program.description: Absolute path to a saved .kedi program, or a Zed task variable resolving to one.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the worktree root.

args.description: Program arguments, passed without shell parsing.

env.description: Debuggee environment overrides. Use null to remove an inherited variable. Prefer inherited credentials over committed secrets.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop before the first executable Kedi statement.

kediAdapter.description: Optional Kedi model adapter. Translated to the DAP launch adapter field; Zed reserves adapter for the debugger name.
